crossRefs.note: They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope at noonday as in the night.
“Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won’t shine.
He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

They will pass through it, very distressed and hungry. It will happen that when they are hungry, they will worry, and…
and look to the earth, and see distress, darkness, and the gloom of anguish. They will be driven into thick darkness.

For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but Yahweh upholds the righteous.

translations.web: From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.
translations.bsb: Light is withheld from the wicked, and their upraised arm is broken.
translations.kjv: And from the wicked their light is withholden, and the high arm shall be broken.
translations.asv: And from the wicked their light is withholden, And the high arm is broken.
